name: role-prompt-ab-replay-usage-measurement
title: Story 3: establish isolated role-prompt A/B replay and usage measurement
description: Implement the third milestone of the canonical role-prompt modularization plan: a read-only historical-material replay harness that deterministically compares pinned prompt contracts/models/samples, records assembled and known-dispatch input plus provider usage/cache and adjudicated findings in experiment-only artifacts, and returns INCONCLUSIVE when source material cannot be reconstructed without mutating production Story evidence.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: The word token refers only to prompt token-count measurement under pinned estimators; this Story does not read, write, transmit, or alter authentication tokens, credentials, secrets, or authorization behavior.

The word production appears only in the negative isolation requirement that experiment artifacts must not mutate production Story evidence; this Story does not deploy to production or change incident/hotfix behavior.
